importantKpis.name: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
importantKpis.description: Measures how effectively manufacturing equipment is utilized based on availability, performance, and quality.

importantKpis.name: Production Volume
importantKpis.description: Total number of units produced during a specific time period.

importantKpis.name: Production Capacity Utilization
importantKpis.description: Percentage of actual production output relative to maximum production capacity.

importantKpis.name: Cycle Time
importantKpis.description: Average time required to produce a single unit or batch.

importantKpis.name: Throughput
importantKpis.description: Number of units produced or processed per unit of time.

importantKpis.name: Yield Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of products manufactured correctly without rework or defects.

importantKpis.name: First Pass Yield (FPY)
importantKpis.description: Percentage of products manufactured correctly the first time without requiring rework.

importantKpis.name: Scrap Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of materials or products discarded due to defects.

importantKpis.name: Defect Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of manufactured products that fail quality standards.

importantKpis.name: Rework Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of products that require additional work to meet quality standards.

importantKpis.name: Downtime
importantKpis.description: Total time production equipment is not operational due to failures or maintenance.

importantKpis.name: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
importantKpis.description: Average time between equipment breakdowns or failures.

importantKpis.name: Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
importantKpis.description: Average time required to repair equipment and restore production.

importantKpis.name: Schedule Adherence
importantKpis.description: Percentage of production completed according to the planned production schedule.

importantKpis.name: On-Time Production Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of manufacturing orders completed on or before the scheduled time.

importantKpis.name: Work in Progress (WIP)
importantKpis.description: Number of partially completed goods currently in the production process.

importantKpis.name: Inventory Turnover
importantKpis.description: Frequency at which manufacturing inventory is used and replenished over a period.

importantKpis.name: Raw Material Utilization
importantKpis.description: Percentage of raw materials effectively used in production.

importantKpis.name: Manufacturing Cost per Unit
importantKpis.description: Average cost incurred to produce a single unit of product.

importantKpis.name: Labor Productivity
importantKpis.description: Output produced per labor hour worked.

importantKpis.name: Energy Consumption per Unit
importantKpis.description: Average amount of energy consumed to manufacture one unit.

importantKpis.name: Machine Utilization Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of available machine time used for production.

importantKpis.name: Setup Time
importantKpis.description: Time required to prepare equipment for a production run.

importantKpis.name: Changeover Time
importantKpis.description: Time required to switch production from one product type to another.

importantKpis.name: Order Fulfillment Cycle Time
importantKpis.description: Time taken from receiving a manufacturing order to completing production.

importantKpis.name: Supplier Defect Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of raw materials received from suppliers that fail quality inspection.

importantKpis.name: Production Plan Attainment
importantKpis.description: Percentage of planned production targets actually achieved.

importantKpis.name: Return Rate
importantKpis.description: Percentage of manufactured products returned by customers due to defects or quality issues.

importantKpis.name: Safety Incident Rate
importantKpis.description: Number of workplace safety incidents relative to total working hours.

importantKpis.name: Waste Generation Rate
importantKpis.description: Amount of production waste generated relative to total output.
